Jio Platforms IPO Opens October 21 with Rs 30,200 Crore Issue

Jio Platforms' Initial Public Offering (IPO) is set to open on October 21 and close on October 23, 2026. The issue is valued at ₹30,200 crore, with a price band of ₹1,065-1,119 per share. The company's valuation is reported at ₹10.3 lakh crore. Ahead of the opening, the grey market premium (GMP) is at 20%, signaling a potential premium of ₹220 per share on listing. Brokerages like Emkay Global and SBI Securities have noted Jio's telecom leadership, earnings growth, and digital expansion, while also pointing out concerns regarding valuation, regulatory aspects, and capital expenditure.
